Select approved drugs with mechanism of action classified as BLOCKER. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_mechanism on molregno, filter drug_mechanism.action_type to BLOCKER, and filter molecule_dictionary.max_phase to 4. Join target_dictionary on drug_mechanism.tid to get target ChEMBL ID and name. Join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical SMILES. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, target_name. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, target_name.
